overview: The flagship project of Majid Al Futtaim, Aura Tilal Al Ghaf, offers an unmatched living experience with its array of elegant and modern 4-bedroom twin villas, all of which have a rooftop patio—the Sky Suites. This beautifully designed community is perfectly situated in the centre of Dubai, surrounded by lush gardens and resort-style amenities, and provides residents with a lifestyle that perfectly strikes the balance between comfort and luxury.
